title: The Fruit of Once-Return
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 55.56 Linked Discourses 55.56
  • 6. Sappaññavagga 6. A Wise Person

Sakadāgāmiphalasutta The Fruit of Once-Return

“Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya saṁvattanti. “Mendicants, when four things are developed and cultivated they lead to the realization of the fruit of once-return. …” Katame cattāro? … pe Saṁvattantī”ti.

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
